setup: Use a disposable database and export the real effective persona. Seed real completed user/assistant pairs through Store or chat API. Keep feedback, frozen dialogue cases, memories, tool results and clock anchors identical across variants; never use preview messages as evolution evidence.
review: Human blind comparison, not keyword counts or forced intimacy. Run the existing 24 audit dialogues before/after. Score core identity, factuality, task correctness, autonomy, scene-appropriate naturalness, and whether the change specifically addresses feedback. Repeat across at least two configured model families without regenerating the profile merely because the model changed.
